gear.description: Tiny, triangle-shaped iron spikes. Living creatures who step on caltrops take 1 damage and can only move at half speed for 10 rounds.

gear.name: Carriage
gear.description: A carriage for one carter and up to four passengers. Needs two to four draft horses to pull it.

gear.name: Cart
gear.description: A simple cart to haul stuff. Needs one or two draft horses to pull it

gear.name: Chalk
gear.description: These writing implements allow you to write on most wall types.

gear.name: Charcoal
gear.description: These writing implements allow you to write on most wall types.

gear.name: Climbing Gloves
gear.description: These leather gloves are embedded with metal spikes for climbing trees and walls with uneven surfaces.

gear.name: Coin
gear.description: One gold piece (gp) is worth 10 silver pieces (sp) and 100 copper pieces (cp).

gear.name: Cold Weather Clothes
gear.description: Gives you advantage to resist the effects of cold weather.

gear.name: Crossbow bolts
gear.description: Ammunition for crossbows.

gear.name: Crowbar
gear.description: Grants advantage on checks to pry open stuck objects.

gear.name: Disguise Kit
gear.description: Cosmetics, hair dye, and small props that let you create disguises that slightly change your physical appearance.

gear.name: Draft Horse
gear.description: A horse to pull a cart

gear.name: Flask
gear.description: Glass containers that hold one draught of liquid.

gear.name: Flint and steel
gear.description: A small fire starter. With it, routine attempts to light a fire always succeed.

gear.name: Gem
gear.description: Gems come in numerous varieties and are very valuable.

gear.name: Grappling hook
gear.description: A rope anchor with three, curved tines.

gear.name: Holy Water Flask
gear.description: Blessed by a priest of a lawful deity, undead will avoid an area where it has been emptied for a day. Splashing the contents on an undead creature directly deals 1d4 damage to it.

gear.name: Hunting Trap
gear.description: An unaware creature stepping on this trap takes 1d4 damage and must pry it open with a DC 11 STR check to be able to move again.

gear.name: Iron spikes
gear.description: Strong spikes. Each has a hole for threading rope. Can be hammered in with weapons or other iron spikes.

gear.name: Lantern
gear.description: Casts light up to a double near distance (see Light, pg. 84). Requires oil. Has a shutter to hide the light.

gear.name: Lock
gear.description: Every lock comes with exactly one key

gear.name: Magnifying Glass
gear.description: Allows you examine the fine details of an object you examine. You can also light a fire on a sunny day by focusing sunlight on some kindling.

gear.name: Manacles
gear.description: These metal restraints can bind a creature. Escaping (DEX) or breaking (STR) the manacles requires a successful DC 20 check.

gear.name: Mining Helmet
gear.description: Uses oil to make light in a near area. If you are hit with a powerful attack on the head, it may fall off and break.

gear.name: Mining Pick
gear.description: Grants advantage to extract valuable ores or gems from stone. Deals 1d3 damage if used as a weapon, but it will break on a natural 1.

gear.name: Mirror
gear.description: A small, polished mirror.

gear.name: Oil, flask
gear.description: Fuels a lantern for one hour of real time. One flask covers a close area and burns for 4 rounds, dealing 1d4 damage each round.

gear.name: Perfume
gear.description: Perfume changes your smell (for the better or worse).

gear.name: Pole
gear.description: Wooden, 10ft long.

gear.name: Ram (portable)
gear.description: ADV on checks to break down a door

gear.name: Rations
gear.description: One day of food and water supply for one person.

gear.name: Riding Horse
gear.description: A horse to ride. May panic in battle

gear.name: Rope
gear.description: Hemp, 60ft long.

gear.name: Shovel
gear.description: Grants advantage to move soil, sand, and loose rocks. Deals 1d3 damage if used as a weapon, but it will break on a natural 1.

gear.name: Steel Mirror
gear.description: Can be used to look around corners or signal with light.

gear.name: Torch
gear.description: Sheds light to a near distance (see Light Sources, pg. 84). Burns for one hour of real time.

gear.name: Warhorse
gear.description: A horse to ride in battle

magicItems.name: Alabaster Destrier
magicItems.description: A smooth, pearly statuette of a running horse. Once per day, the wielder can speak the command word to turn the statuette into a pegasus that accepts neutral or lawful riders. The statuette remains in this form for 1 hour.

magicItems.name: Amulet of Secrecy
magicItems.description: A heavy, flat pendant carved with a lidded eye. You can't be detected by divination magic such as the scrying spell or a Crystal Ball while wearing this amulet.

magicItems.name: Amulet of Vitality
magicItems.description: A gold amulet with a red ruby teardrop at its center. Your Constitution stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this amulet.

magicItems.name: Armor of Saint Terragnis
magicItems.description:
Golden plate mail carved from head to toe with warrior angels. Hostile spells that target you are DC 18 to cast.
Once per month, you can summon an Avatar of Saint Terragnis (treat as an archangel) to fight by your side for 10 rounds.

magicItems.name: Armor of the Oni
magicItems.description: Black plate mail of lacquered, ironwood panels. The helm's visor is the face of a snarling oni. You can speak and understand Diabolic. Your melee weapon attacks deal +1 damage.

magicItems.name: Bag of Badgers
magicItems.description: A gray, fraying sack matted with white, bristly hair. Once per day, you can reach inside the bag and pull out an angry badger. You can throw the badger up to a near distance. The badger attacks the nearest creature for 3 rounds before waddling away.

magicItems.name: Bag of Devouring
magicItems.description: A worn, leather pouch with tight drawstrings.

magicItems.name: Bag of Holding
magicItems.description: A worn, leather pouch with tight drawstrings. This bag has an interdimensional space inside that can hold up to 10 gear slots.

magicItems.name: Bead of Force
magicItems.description: A marble with a blue ring of light glowing softly inside it. You can throw this bead at one target up to a near distance. If you hit, the target becomes caught in a resilient sphere spell.

magicItems.name: Blade of Vengeance
magicItems.description: A gray blade with a diamondcut ruby in the pommel. It whistles sharply with each slice. You have advantage on attacks against undead creatures with this sword. You can use the sword to cast turn undead once per day (+4 bonus).

magicItems.name: Boots of Dancing
magicItems.description: Fine, supple boots of sheepskin.

magicItems.name: Boots of Hovering
magicItems.description: Brown, sturdy boots polished to a sheen. Small, silver wings adorn the heels. You can walk on an insubstantial surface for 1 turn at a time. You fall through the surface if you end your turn on it.

magicItems.name: Boots of the Cat
magicItems.description: Grey, doeskin boots as thin and soft as slippers. You can jump up to a near distance from a standstill. Your checks to move silently are always easy (DC 9).

magicItems.name: Bracers of Archery
magicItems.description: Leather bracers embossed with soaring hawks. You deal +1 damage with ranged weapons.

magicItems.name: Bracers of Defense
magicItems.description: Steel bracers traced with dwarvish runes of protection. You get a +1 bonus to your armor class.

magicItems.name: Brak's Book of Misspells
magicItems.description: A tome bound in ratskin that bears a jagged, glowing rune.

magicItems.name: Brak's Cube of Perfection
magicItems.description:
A tiny cube with paintings of goblins on each face, each one depicting transcendence in a physical or mental trait. Roll the cube by rolling a d6. Your corresponding stat permanently increases to 18
(+4). 1. Strength. 2. Dexterity. 3. Constitution. 4. Intelligence. 5. Wisdom. 6. Charisma.
After being rolled, Brak's Cube of Perfection teleports to a random location in the multiverse.

magicItems.name: Circlet of Wisdom
magicItems.description: A thin, silver circlet set with a shimmering, blue pearl. Your Wisdom stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this circlet.

magicItems.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
magicItems.description: A hooded, billowing cloak that shifts colors to match its surroundings. Your checks to hide are always easy (DC 9). Once per day, you can become invisible for 5 rounds. The invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

magicItems.name: Cloak of the Bat
magicItems.description: A leathery, black cloak that has a ragged hem and a hood with pointed ears. You can fly a near distance as your movement while in a shadowy area.

magicItems.name: Crystal Ball
magicItems.description:
A flawless glass orb with roiling images swirling inside it. Only wizards can use a Crystal Ball. You can use it to cast the scrying spell.
If you fail the spellcasting check to cast scrying, the Crystal Ball ceases to function for a day.

magicItems.name: Dagger of the Goblin Hero
magicItems.description: A curved dagger with a halfmoon notch at the blade's base. You can speak Goblin. All goblinoid creatures react to you with a friendly attitude.

magicItems.name: Egg of the Cockatrice
magicItems.description: A blue, hard egg as big as a coconut and heavy as a stone. Once per week, you can speak a command word that causes a cockatrice to hatch and follow your commands for 5 rounds before flying away. The  egg repairs itself over one week.

magicItems.name: Flying Carpet
magicItems.description: A richly woven, red carpet with gold tassels. The carpet fits two riders (one is the driver). It can fly double near on the driver's turn.

magicItems.name: Gauntlets of Might
magicItems.description: Heavy, bronze gauntlets with engravings of Herculean giants. Your Strength stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing these gauntlets.

magicItems.name: Genie Lamp
magicItems.description: A tarnished, brass oil lamp. Rubbing the lamp causes its resident djinni (50% chance) or efreeti (50% chance) to emerge. A djinni grants its summoner one wish spell before disappearing. An efreeti does the same, but only after being defeated in combat.

magicItems.name: Gloves of Agility
magicItems.description: Thin, leather gloves that seem to meld with the wearer's hands. Your Dexterity stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing these gloves.

magicItems.name: Goblin Bomb
magicItems.description: A preserved rat stuffed with an explosive charge and a fuse. You can light the bomb's fuse and throw it a near distance. It explodes in 1d4 rounds, dealing 2d8 damage to everything in near range.

magicItems.name: Greataxe of The Horde
magicItems.description: A jagged greataxe carved from a weighty dragon bone. Once Per Day, You Can Turn A Regular Hit With This Weapon Into A Critical Hit.

magicItems.name: Hat of Intellect
magicItems.description: A floppy, pointed hat with a wide brim. Your Intelligence stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this hat.

magicItems.name: Hat of the Hound
magicItems.description: A rounded, jaunty bowler hat. You can transform into a mastiff each day for up to 10 rounds total. Your clothing and possessions transform with you.

magicItems.name: Helm of Mind Reading
magicItems.description: A helm carved with brain ridges, a spinal neck-guard, and octopus-like tentacles. You can cast the detect thoughts spell three times per day (+4 bonus).

magicItems.name: Horned Helm of Ramlaat
magicItems.description:
A bloodstained helm made of a ram's skull. This helm grants you a +1 bonus to your armor class.
You have advantage on any check you make to knock down creatures or objects.

magicItems.name: Hourglass of the Black Sands
magicItems.description: An ancient hourglass running with obsidian sand. Once per day, you can turn the hourglass when you cast a spell. The spell's effects last 1d4 rounds longer.

magicItems.name: Immovable Rod
magicItems.description: A short, bejeweled iron rod with a button on one end. When you click the button, the rod becomes fixed in space. Clicking the button again ends the effect.

magicItems.name: Jewel of Barbalt
magicItems.description: A glistening, coconut-sized ruby held in golden claws. You roll a critical success on an 18-20.

magicItems.name: Kytherian Cog
magicItems.description: A coin-sized, toothed wheel buffed to a silvery shine. You start every session with a luck token.

magicItems.name: Longbow of the Elven Kings
magicItems.description: A deeply curved longbow with deer antler reinforcements. You have advantage on attacks with this bow against unnatural aberrations and outsiders.

magicItems.name: Magic Ink
magicItems.description:
A pot of glossy, black ink that disappears as it dries. The ink's writing is invisible when cool and can only be seen when warmed up by a nearby source of strong heat.
There's enough for 1d4 uses.

magicItems.name: Memnon's Blazing Javelin
magicItems.description: This golden javelin occasionally blinks and wavers, briefly turning into a bolt of lightning. The javelin always returns to your hand after being thrown. Once per day, when you throw this javelin, you can turn it into lighting as per the lightning bolt spell (you do not have to make a spellcasting check).

magicItems.name: Memnon's Discordant Blade
magicItems.description: This barbed greatsword's red blade trails a shower of sparks when swung to strike. Once per day, you can utterly annihilate one creature of level 9 or less that you damage with this blade. The creature can pass a DC 18 Constitution check to take 3d8 damage instead.

magicItems.name: Memnon's Entropic Armor
magicItems.description: Deep blue plate mail traced with gold lightning motifs and red gems arrayed into the shape of flames. Once per day, you can speak the armor's command word. Until your next turn, all non-magical weapons that strike you are instantly unmade, shattering into dust. You take no damage from them.

magicItems.name: Mirror of Mischief
magicItems.description: A full-length mirror polished to a gleaming shine. Grinning, silver demons grasp the mirror, their claws forming its frame.

magicItems.name: Moonwrought Chainmail
magicItems.description: A luminous jacket of chainmail as lightweight as a silk shirt. Once per day, you can speak the armor's command word. You gain a +1 bonus to your next spellcasting check or ranged attack.

magicItems.name: Necklace of Charm
magicItems.description: A gold, fishbone chain that shimmers with subtle beauty. Your Charisma stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing this necklace.

magicItems.name: Necrotic Mace of Withering
magicItems.description: A wrought iron mace tipped with a heavy, screaming skull. Black ichor runs from the skull's eyes when the mace is used to channel necrotic energy. While holding the mace, you can turn cure wounds spells you cast into harmful magic that instead inflicts the same amount of damage it would heal.

magicItems.name: Nightcloak Armor
magicItems.description: Matte black leathers enchanted to deepen and darken shadows. Once per day, you may choose to automatically pass a Dexterity check to hide.

magicItems.name: Obsidian Witchknife
magicItems.description: A glinting, obsidian blade that trails black smoke in thin curls. When you cast a spell while holding this dagger, you may wound yourself with it. Add the amount of damage you take to your spellcasting check.

magicItems.name: Onyx Destrier
magicItems.description: A polished, ebony statuette of a running horse. Once per day, the wielder can speak the command word to turn the statuette into a nightmare that accepts neutral or chaotic riders. The statuette remains in this form for 1 hour.

magicItems.name: Ophidian Armor
magicItems.description: Glistening, smooth leather of dappled emerald scales. You have advantage on checks to avoid the effects of poison.

magicItems.name: Pearl of Power
magicItems.description: A fat, opalescent pearl glowing with an inner radiance. Once per day, you may regain the ability to cast a spell you have lost. This cannot restore a spell lost due to a critical spellcasting failure.

magicItems.name: Pipe of the rolling Hills
magicItems.description: A long, curved pipe that smells of cloves and resin. Up to three times per day, regain 1d4 hit points when you smoke this pipe.

magicItems.name: Pipes of the Sewers
magicItems.description: A set of tarnished, brass pan pipes with seven cylinders. Once per day, you can play these pipes to summon 2d6 giant rats. The rats obey you for d6 rounds, and then they scatter and flee.

magicItems.name: Portable Hole
magicItems.description: A black, velvet square of cloth that unfolds into a wide circle. The Portable Hole folds open on a flat surface into a 6-foot wide, 6-foot deep hole. It has 20 gear slots of storage. The hole closes when you fold the cloth into a small square.

magicItems.name: Potion of Extirpation
magicItems.description: An acrid, tarry substance in an iron flask with a lead stopper. You can pour the potion on one object or creature filling up to a close area. The target is utterly removed from reality and cannot be returned by anything short of a wish spell.

magicItems.name: Potion of Flying
magicItems.description: A sunny liquid with bubbles that flash and pop like tiny stars. You can fly a near  distance for 10 rounds when you drink this potion.

magicItems.name: Potion of Forgetfulness
magicItems.description: A pink draught that swirls with a counter-clockwise current. If you serve this potion to an intelligent being and that being drinks it, the imbiber permanently forgets one memory of your choosing.

magicItems.name: Potion of Giant Strength
magicItems.description: A clay jar holding a stew of green, leafy sludge. Your Strength becomes 18 (+4) and you deal x2 damage on melee attacks for 10 rounds.

magicItems.name: Potion of Healing
magicItems.description: A glass bottle with a fizzy, lemon-vanilla liquid inside. The imbiber of this potion regains hit points based on its level.

magicItems.name: Potion of Invisibility
magicItems.description: This glass vial appears to be empty, but a liquid audibly splashes around inside it. When you drink this potion, you become invisible for 10 rounds or until you attack or cast a spell.

magicItems.name: Potion of Legendary Deeds
magicItems.description: A golden elixir that resonates with a faint, angelic chord. When you drink this potion, you gain one level and your XP total resets to zero.

magicItems.name: Potion of Polymorph
magicItems.description: A pickled newt floats in this lavender flask of clear liquid. When you drink this potion, it casts the polymorph spell on you with a duration of 1 hour instead of 10 rounds.

magicItems.name: Potion of Vitality
magicItems.description: A crimson elixir that gently thumps with a heartbeat. When you drink this potion, roll your class's hit points die. You permanently gain that many HP.

magicItems.name: Ring of Feather Falling
magicItems.description: A pearly ring carved in the likeness of an owl feather. Once per day, the ring can cast feather fall on you when you fall.

magicItems.name: Ring of Fireballs
magicItems.description:
A bronze loop with claws holding a red marble. A fiery miasma swirls inside the glass. You can pluck the glass marble from the ring and throw it up to a far distance, causing a fireball spell to bloom at the site of impact.
The glass marble regrows after you successfully complete a rest.

magicItems.name: Ring of Invisibility
magicItems.description: A simple, gold band polished to a warm shine. Once per day, the ring can cast the invisibility spell on you.

magicItems.name: Ring of Ramlaat
magicItems.description:
A bone-carved ring with a ram skull. Its horns twist forward and  red lights glow in its eye sockets. Once per day, you can enter a rage where you deal double damage for 5 rounds.
During the rage, you can't cast spells and enemies have advantage on melee attacks against you.

magicItems.name: Robe of the Archmage
magicItems.description:
A red silk robe with a wide, goldhemmed mantle. Golden eyes and moons dust its sleeves. Only a wizard with the Archmage title can wear this robe.
Your unarmored AC becomes 15 plus your Dexterity modifier. 
Choose three spells you know. Their spellcasting DC is always 11.
You have advantage on casting the disintegrate spell.

magicItems.name: Robe of the Druid
magicItems.description:
A green velvet robe with a deep hood and hems embroidered with silver leaves and vines. Only a wizard with the Druid title can wear this robe.
Your unarmored AC becomes 15 plus your Dexterity modifier. 
Twice per day, you can regain the ability to cast one lost spell.
You have advantage on casting the shapechange spell. When you cast it, its duration is 1 hour instead of focus.

magicItems.name: Robe of the Sorcerer
magicItems.description:
A black leather robe with a shadowed cowl and clawed clasps on thin, mithral chains. Only a wizard with the Sorcerer title can wear this robe.
Your unarmored AC becomes 15 plus your Dexterity modifier. 
When you cast a spell that deals damage, add your Intelligence modifier to the total.
You have advantage on casting the power word kill spell.

magicItems.name: Scarab of Protection
magicItems.description: A brooch made from a horned scarab beetle dipped in gold. If you die, make a DC 18 Constitution check. If you succeed, you are unconscious instead of dead.

magicItems.name: Scimitar of the Ash Moon
magicItems.description: This wide, curved blade has a snarling efreeti head on the bronze pommel. If you roll a critical hit with this weapon, the target is beheaded. It dies instantly if decapitation would kill it.

magicItems.name: Shield of the Crusader
magicItems.description: A weighty kite shield painted with a faded, crimson cross. Once per day, you can speak a prayer to wreathe the shield in holy flames, granting +2 to your AC for 3 rounds.

magicItems.name: Shield of the Lion
magicItems.description: This shield is carved as a roaring lion's face with a ˹owing mane. Once per day, you can command the lion to animate and bellow a ferocious roar. All hostile creatures within near range must immediately make a morale check.

magicItems.name: Shield of the Witchّking
magicItems.description: A jagged triangle of black steel with spiny, armored plates. You take half damage from undead creatures.

magicItems.name: Shortsword of the Thief
magicItems.description: A stubby, grey blade riddled with notches and scars. Once per day, regain a luck token you just spent.

magicItems.name: Silver Mace of Wrath
magicItems.description: A tarnished, silver mace with seven ˹anges in the shape of  crescent moons. This weapon deals double damage against creatures with lycanthropy.

magicItems.name: Sphere of Annihilation
magicItems.description:
A three-foot, spherical void of pure darkness that hovers above the ground. This sphere utterly destroys all matter it touches.
Intelligent beings can move the flying sphere a near distance by passing a DC 18 Intelligence check. If multiple creatures vie for control of the sphere, it is a contested Intelligence check, instead. Wizards have advantage on this check. The winner moves the sphere a near distance.
If the sphere moves into a space occupied by a creature, the being controlling the sphere makes an attack roll against that creature with a +7 bonus. On a hit, the creature is obliterated.

magicItems.name: Spyglass of True Sight
magicItems.description: A brass, telescoping lens with magical runes carved on it. When you look through the spyglass, you can see invisible creatures and objects.

magicItems.name: Staff of Healing
magicItems.description: A knotted, oak stave with a heavy knurl on one end. Once per day, you can touch a creature with the staff to heal it for 1d6 hit points.

magicItems.name: Staff of Ord
magicItems.description:
A tapered, mithral staff that resonates with arcane power. The tip features an upwardlooking eye in a circle of runes. Functions as a wand of dimension door, fireball, sending, and telekinesis.
Unlike a wand, the staff remains intact if you roll a 1 on your spellcasting checks.
Hostile spells targeting you are DC 18 to cast.

magicItems.name: Staff of the Cobra
magicItems.description:
A curved scepter tipped with a ruby-eyed, glaring cobra head. All snakes regard you with a friendly attitude unless you do something to upset them.
Once per day, you can throw the staff to the ground. It becomes a giant snake for 5 rounds that obeys your mental commands. If the giant snake goes to 0 HP, it reverts into a staff.

magicItems.name: Sword of the Ancients
magicItems.description: A chipped and rusting blade with an oiled leather grip. The sword is unbreakable and can carve through any material.

magicItems.name: The Kytherian Mechanism
magicItems.description:
A towering, brass platform mounted with countless cogs and gears speckled in bluegreen rust. A handle turns The Kytherian Mechanism's mighty wheels, but it doesn't function until its seven missing Kytherian Cogs are replaced.
Once functional, activating the mechanism allows the operator to undo one event of their choosing from history. Then, the seven Kytherian Cogs magically scatter to far-flung locations.

magicItems.name: The Malediction Infernal
magicItems.description:
A black, leatherbound tome with a grinning demon face embossed on the cover. A chaotic being who reads this tome gains a level and learns the Diabolic language.
A non-chaotic being who reads this book must pass a DC 18
Wisdom check or lose one level.
After being read, the tome teleports to a far-flung location.

magicItems.name: Thrice-blessed Sword
magicItems.description: A lustrous, golden-handled blade anointed with blessed tears, incense, and prayers. You deal double damage against demons, devils, and undead.

magicItems.name: Tome Mordanticus
magicItems.description:
A hand-drawn bestiary of the multiverse's most notable creatures and people. When you read the tome, you learn three True Names of three beings you choose.
Your True Name also appears in the book after reading it.

magicItems.name: Tome of Gehemna
magicItems.description: A sturdy, russet volume held by metal clasps. A golden eye in a circle adorns the cover. Each day, a random wizard spell scroll appears inside the tome, replacing the spell scroll from the prior day.

magicItems.name: Tome of Hadebe
magicItems.description: A brass-plated book with pages of etched copper leaf. The tome contains one each of the following scrolls: burning hands, fireball, and prismatic orb.

magicItems.name: Trident of the Seas
magicItems.description:
A three-pronged, mithral harpoon studded with pearls. You can breathe underwater, as well as speak to and understand wild sea creatures.
Once per day, you can cast control water with a +4 bonus.

magicItems.name: True Name
magicItems.description: The secret, unique name borne by a creature and documented in The Covenant. Few creatures know their own True Names. You have advantage on attack rolls and spellcasting checks targeting a creature whose True Name you utter.

magicItems.name: Wand of Unlife
magicItems.description: The knobby bone-finger of a swamp troll steeped in acrid embalming fluid. This wand contains the spells animate dead and create undead.

magicItems.name: Wand of Warding
magicItems.description: A thin, weighty rod of dark iron inscribed with spiraling runes. This wand contains the spells dispel magic and protection from energy.

magicItems.name: War Horn of The Angels
magicItems.description:
An opalescent ox horn capped with a golden mouthpiece. Only a lawful being can wield the horn. Once per day, you can blow the horn to cast rebuke unholy with a +4 bonus.
A demon or devil who hears the horn has disadvantage on its Charisma check vs. your rebuke unholy spellcasting check.

magicItems.name: Warhammer of the Dwarf Lords
magicItems.description:
A boxy hammer with a stout handle and leather throwing strap. It hums with a baritone resonance when spun. This weapon has the thrown property to a near distance. It always returns to your hand after being thrown.
Your attacks with this weapon deal double damage against giants.
